title: Noise stability via Fourier coefficients
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function and let $\rho \in \bbr$. Then the correlation of $f$ with its noised version under the uniform measure is given by
\[
  \langle f, T_\rho f\rangle \;=\; \sum_{S\subseteq[n]} \rho^{|S|}\,\hat f(S)^2,
\]
where $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ is the $L^2$ inner product, $T_\rho$ is the noise operator, and $\hat f(S)$ denotes the Fourier--Walsh coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: a Boolean function f of arity n
